note: Complaints from public 1-3 star reviews and public comments. Paraphrased in our words, no reviewer names. Reddit and Amazon could not be read from the cloud (blocked), so they are not in here yet. Counts are only what we found, not market totals. Rival-only pass 2026-10-17: Etsy shop and listing pages show only top reviews (all 5 stars seen), Payhip/Gumroad/Thatch show no reviews, so digital rivals have almost no public complaints to read; most rival complaints are about the two pole brands and one park-guide seller. 2026-10-22 pass: winter gear (headlamps, gloves, gaiters) for the headlamp now in store and the plan's cold-weather focus; Etsy digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews. 2026-10-27 pass: the two group-A gear benchmarks (Cascade Mountain Tech poles, Darn Tough socks) from OutdoorGearLab, Trustpilot, REI, review blogs and a hiking forum; Etsy digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews. 2026-11-01 pass: group A gear benchmarks (Montem poles from a 2026 review roundup, Darn Tough from Trustpilot); Etsy and Payhip digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews or none. 2026-11-05 pass: group C; Hiker Hunger pole reviews from a reseller page; Etsy, Payhip and Gumroad digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews or none. 2026-11-07 pass: group A; Etsy and Payhip digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews or none, so this run read critical points in public 4-star reviews of a well-known packable daypack and fleece jacket (Zappos, 2021-2023), the closest benchmarks to our 18L pack and polar fleeces. Older dates, marked as 4-star criticism. 2026-11-09 pass: group B; Etsy and Payhip digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews or none, so this run read hiking sock reviews (our first sale was merino socks) and a national parks passport stamp book (we are building a State Parks Passport). 2026-11-13 pass: group A; Etsy and Payhip digital rivals again show only 5-star reviews or none, Darn Tough has no new Trustpilot reviews since Oct 21; added a Montem pole handle failure, a basic map in a park passport book, and a kids nature card game (small set, poor value).
